firstGlobal.reason: Host recognition used the whole utterance and mistook an option-mentioned chicken SKU for a named rice-combo host. Existing 10-box split regression caught it. Fixed binding to product text before the first counted modifier clause.

behaviors: Optional subset note appends to the same units as options; preserves remainder and old notes
Note-only difference can partition even with unchanged options
Invalid note rejects all prepared groups
Cart projection carries the changed note
Counted option distributions own their turn before greedy cart/checkout parsing
Per-variant purchase quantities and attributes are not overwritten by total quantity or the final option
Kitchen note is not copied from another variant
Failure/disabled agent/pending selection cannot create a partial distributed purchase

reproductions.notes: Intermediate development runs included TypeScript/fixture errors and are not acceptance. Use final logs only.

limits: One real inference turn does not establish general language accuracy
Optional subset note appends; contradictory kitchen instructions and deletion require separate semantics
Explicit counted modifier routing supports current phrase family, not every conversational distribution
Joint changes on several subsets of the same original row remain rejected as overlap
New purchases with variants during checkout still need a dedicated acceptance matrix
Pilot requires reserved complete conversations, latency and cost review
paidSourceLimit: The real probe preceded the host-prefix correction; captured actual calls are replayed free on final source. Do not claim a second paid run after that correction.
